description: This Scala source file defines utility functions for handling Hive write operations within Apache Spark, including partition specification, dynamic partition validation, bucket write options, and Hadoop configuration setup for compression.

methods.name: getPartitionSpec
methods.description: Converts a map of partition keys with optional string values into a map with string values, substituting default names or empty strings as needed.

methods.name: getDynamicPartitionColumns
methods.description: Determines the dynamic partition columns for a Hive table, validating partition specifications and resolving attribute references.

methods.name: getOptionsWithHiveBucketWrite
methods.description: Returns a map of options indicating Hive-compatible bucket write if a bucket specification is provided.

methods.name: setupHadoopConfForCompression
methods.description: Configures Hadoop configuration for output file compression based on table format and session settings.
